dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Here's what's happening across your business today.
dashboard.gettingStartedText: The workspace is ready. Modules will appear here as they are built.

widgets.approvalsHint: Approve here, or open the document to review it first.

common.comingSoonText: The {{module}} module hasn't been built yet.
common.notFoundText: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has moved.
common.forbiddenText: You do not have permission to view this page.
common.errorText: An unexpected error occurred. Try again, or go back to the dashboard.

validation.passwordMin: Password must be at least 8 characters
validation.passwordMax: Password must be at most 72 characters
validation.defaultBranch: Default branch must be one of the assigned branches
validation.code: Use letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore
validation.currencyCode: Use the 3-letter ISO code, e.g. USD
validation.duplicateRate: A rate can only be added once
validation.ean13: Not a valid EAN-13 (13 digits with a correct check digit)

brand.headline: Run your entire business from one place.
brand.subheadline: Sales, purchases, inventory, accounting and HR — connected across every branch.
brand.feature1: Real-time stock across warehouses and branches
brand.feature2: Accurate books, VAT-ready invoices and live reports
brand.feature3: Role-based access, two-factor sign-in and full audit trail

auth.signInDescription: Welcome back. Enter your credentials to continue.
auth.twoFactorDescription: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.forgotDescription: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link to reset it.
auth.checkEmailText: If an account exists for {{email}}, you'll receive a password reset link shortly. The link expires in 30 minutes.
auth.resetDoneText: Your password has been reset and all devices were signed out. Sign in with your new password.
auth.linkInvalidText: This password reset link is invalid or has expired.

table.selectAll: Select all rows on this page
table.noMatchesText: Try a different search or clear the filters.

users.title: Users
users.description: Manage who can sign in, their roles and the branches they work in.
users.createDescription: Create an account and choose what the person can access.
users.editDescription: Update account details, roles and branch access.
users.passwordUnchanged: Leave empty to keep the current password.
users.rolesHint: Permissions from all selected roles are combined.
users.branchesHint: The user can only work with data from these branches.
users.lockedUntil: Locked until {{time}} after too many failed sign-ins. Activate the user to unlock now.
users.deleteText: {{name}} will lose access immediately. This cannot be undone.
users.bulkSkipSelf: Your own account and users already in that state are skipped.
users.emptyText: Invite your team to start working together.

roles.title: Roles & Permissions
roles.description: Roles bundle permissions. Assign roles to users to control what they can see and do.
roles.createDescription: Name the role, then pick its permissions in the matrix.
roles.editDescription: Change the role's name or description.
roles.copyFromHint: Copy permissions from an existing role, then adjust.
roles.deleteText: The role "{{name}}" will be removed. Roles that are still assigned to users cannot be deleted.
roles.matrixDescription: Choose what users with this role can do in each module.
roles.superAdminText: This built-in role always has full access and cannot be changed.
roles.leaveText: You changed permissions for this role but haven't saved them.

profile.title: My profile
profile.description: Your personal details, password, two-factor authentication and signed-in devices.
profile.generalDescription: This is how you appear to your team.
profile.avatarHint: JPG, PNG or WEBP, up to {{size}} MB.
profile.avatarType: Please choose a JPG, PNG or WEBP image
profile.avatarSize: The image must be {{size}} MB or smaller
profile.passwordDescription: Use a strong password you don't use anywhere else.
profile.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.
profile.passwordSignOutNote: Changing your password signs you out of all other devices.
profile.twoFactorDescription: Require a code from your phone in addition to your password when signing in.
profile.twoFactorApps: Works with Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy and other TOTP apps.
profile.enableTwoFactorText: Protect your account with a time-based code from an authenticator app.
profile.twoFactorStep1: Open your authenticator app and scan this QR code.
profile.twoFactorStep2: Can't scan? Enter the secret key below manually.
profile.twoFactorStep3: Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app
profile.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
profile.disableTwoFactorText: Confirm with your password and a current code. Your account will be protected by your password only.
profile.sessionsDescription: Devices that are currently signed in to your account.
profile.signOutOthersText_one: {{count}} other device will be signed out immediately.
profile.signOutOthersText_other: {{count}} other devices will be signed out immediately.
profile.othersSignedOut: Signed out of all other devices
profile.historyDescription: Your last 20 sign-in attempts. Report anything you don't recognise.

crud.deleteText: “{{name}}” will be removed. This cannot be undone.

company.title: Company profile
company.description: Your business identity on invoices, receipts and reports.
company.logoHint: Shown on invoices and receipts. JPG, PNG or WEBP up to 2 MB; a wide logo on a transparent background works best.
company.detailsHint: Printed in document headers. BIN appears on every VAT invoice (Mushak-6.3).

branches.title: Branches
branches.description: Locations of your business. Users and stock belong to branches.
branches.headOfficeHint: Exactly one branch is the head office. Setting this moves it from the current one.
branches.codeHint: Used in document numbers, e.g. INV-DHK-2026-00001

warehouses.title: Warehouses
warehouses.description: Where stock is kept. Each warehouse belongs to a branch.
warehouses.defaultHint: Used when a document of this branch doesn’t name a warehouse.

financial.title: Financial settings
financial.description: Base currency, fiscal year and how amounts are rounded and shown.
financial.baseCurrencyHint: Books are kept in this currency.
financial.multiCurrencyHint: Allow documents in other currencies (converted with exchange rates).
financial.fyPreview: Fiscal year runs from {{start}} for 12 months. Bangladesh: 1 July – 30 June.
financial.pricesIncludeTaxHint: New products and documents treat entered prices as VAT-inclusive.
financial.baseChangeConfirm: All amounts will be booked in {{code}}. Exchange rates saved for {{code}} will be removed. Do this only before you start recording transactions.

currencies.title: Currencies
currencies.description: Currencies you trade in and their exchange rates against the base currency.
currencies.baseHint: Exchange rates say how much 1 unit is worth in {{base}}. Change the base currency in Financial settings.
currencies.ratesDescription: The latest rate on or before a document’s date is used to convert {{code}} to {{base}}.

taxes.title: Taxes
taxes.description: VAT, supplementary duty and other rates, combined into tax groups for products.
taxes.groupRatesHint: Taxes apply top to bottom. A compound tax is charged on the price plus the taxes above it — e.g. VAT on the SD-inclusive value.
taxes.calculatorHint: Try a group on an amount. Uses exactly the same calculation as invoices.

paymentMethods.title: Payment methods
paymentMethods.description: How customers pay you and how you pay suppliers.
paymentMethods.sortOrderHint: Lower numbers appear first at the POS.
paymentMethods.requiresReferenceHint: Ask for a transaction ID, card slip or cheque number.

numbering.title: Document numbering
numbering.description: Number series for invoices, orders and vouchers — per branch or company-wide.
numbering.intro: A branch uses its own series when it has one; otherwise the company-wide series. Numbers are never reused, even when two documents are saved at the same moment.
numbering.resetYearlyHint: Numbering restarts at 1 on 1 January (company timezone).
numbering.branchHint: Company-wide series apply to branches without their own.
numbering.previewError: Fix the highlighted fields to see a preview
numbering.tokens: Tokens: {BRANCH} branch code · {YYYY} year · {YY} short year · {MM} month

units.title: Units of measure
units.description: Units used for buying, stocking and selling, and how they convert.
units.allowDecimalHint: Allow quantities like 2.5 (kg, litre). Off for pieces and boxes.
units.conversionsDescription: Standard conversions, e.g. 1 box = 12 pcs. Products can define their own packs later.

printTemplates.title: Print templates
printTemplates.description: Layouts for invoices and receipts — A4 and 80 mm thermal.
printTemplates.isDefaultHint: Used when printing this document on this paper size.

email.title: Email (SMTP)
email.description: Send password resets, invoices and notifications from your own mail server.
email.enabledHint: When off, the server-wide email settings are used.
email.disabledInfo: Company SMTP is off — emails use the server’s default sender.
email.passwordSaved: A password is saved. Leave empty to keep it.
email.testHint: Checks the saved settings by sending a short message.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: How dates, times and the interface look for everyone in the company.
preferences.cardHint: Users can still switch language for themselves from the top bar.
preferences.themeColorHint: Accent colour for buttons and highlights.

backups.title: Backups
backups.description: Download a complete copy of the database, or let the system make one on a schedule.
backups.securityNote: Backups contain all data, including password hashes. Store downloaded files somewhere safe and never share them.
backups.scheduleHint: Runs on the server in Bangladesh time. Old automatic backups are removed beyond the number you keep.
backups.retentionHint: Manual backups are never removed automatically.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.description: How stock is valued, controlled and monitored.
inventory.cardHint: These rules apply to every warehouse of the company.
inventory.costingHint: How the cost of stock leaving a warehouse is measured. You can switch at any time; stock already on hand keeps its value.

methodHints.weighted_average: Every issue is valued at the item's current average cost in that warehouse.
methodHints.fifo: Issues take the cost of the oldest stock received first.

inventory.requireApprovalHint: Adjustments, opening stock, damage/scrap and count results wait for a user with the Approve permission before they change stock.
inventory.allowNegativeHint: Lets stock-outs exceed the quantity on hand. Batch- and serial-tracked items can never go negative.
inventory.deadAfterSlow: Must be more than the slow-moving days

purchase.title: Purchase
purchase.description: Approval levels, receiving tolerance and default terms for purchasing.
purchase.cardHint: Applies to every branch of the company.
purchase.approvalLevelsHint: An order needs every level whose amount is at or below its total, in order, each by a different person. With no levels, orders are approved on submit.
purchase.noLevels: No approval levels — orders are approved as soon as they are submitted.
purchase.increasing: Each level must start at a higher amount than the one before
purchase.requisitionApprovalHint: Off: submitted requisitions are approved straight away.
purchase.overReceiptHint: How much more than ordered a goods receipt may take in. 0 = never more than ordered.
purchase.paymentTermsHint: Used when the supplier has no terms of its own.
purchase.defaultTermsHint: Printed on purchase orders; can be changed per order.

sales.title: Sales
sales.description: Rounding, credit-limit check, default terms and automatic payment reminders.
sales.cardHint: Applied to new quotations, orders and invoices.
sales.roundToHint: The difference is shown on the invoice as “Round off”.
sales.creditCheckHint: Orders and invoices that take a customer over the credit limit are blocked. Users with the sales approve permission can override with a reason.
sales.paymentTermsHint: Used when the customer has no terms of their own.
sales.quotationValidityHint: Default “valid until” date of a new quotation.
sales.defaultTermsHint: Printed on quotations, orders and invoices unless the document has its own.
sales.remindersHint: Emails the customer about unpaid invoices every morning at 09:00 (Asia/Dhaka). Needs email settings.
sales.dayListFormat: Enter whole days separated by commas

pos.title: Point of sale
pos.description: Registers, cashier limits, receipts and offline selling.
pos.cardHint: Apply to every register of the company.
pos.maxDiscountHint: Above this, a user with POS update permission must give the discount.
pos.allowPriceEditHint: Otherwise only users with POS update permission can change a price.
pos.denominations: Notes and coins counted at closing
pos.quickCashHint: Shown on the payment screen, e.g. 500, 1000, 2000
pos.autoPrintHint: Opens the print dialog as soon as a sale is completed.
pos.offlineHint: Items and customers are kept on the device; sales are queued and synced when the connection is back.
pos.footerHint: Printed at the bottom of every receipt.
pos.registersHint: Each counter sells from one warehouse; its branch is the warehouse's branch.
pos.registerHint: The code prefixes the register's Z report numbers.
pos.walkInHint: Used when the cashier doesn't choose a customer.
pos.deleteText: Registers that have sessions can't be deleted — make them inactive instead.

accounting.title: Accounting
accounting.description: Ledger accounts used by automatic postings and payment methods.
accounting.postingHint: Every sale, purchase, payment and stock movement posts to these accounts. Leave one on the default to use the standard account.

hints.cash: Cash payment methods without their own account.
hints.bank: Bank transfers and cheques without their own account.
hints.cardClearing: Card payments until the bank settles them.
hints.sales: Invoices and POS sales, net of discount and VAT.
hints.ap: What the company owes suppliers (per supplier).
hints.grni: Clears goods receipts against supplier bills.
hints.landedCost: Freight, duty and other costs added to stock.
hints.purchaseVariance: Differences on returns and debit notes.
hints.cogs: Cost of stock delivered to customers.
hints.retainedEarnings: Receives the profit or loss when a year is closed.
hints.openingBalanceEquity: Balances opening balances and opening stock.

accounting.methodsHint: The cash or bank account each payment method moves money through.

import.title: Import {{entities}}
import.description: Rows are checked before anything is saved. Existing records (same code / SKU) are updated.
import.step1Hint: Fill in the first sheet; the Instructions sheet explains every column.
import.choose: Choose an .xlsx file or drop it here
import.errorReport: Download the file with errors marked
import.allValid: All rows are valid — ready to import.
import.skipInvalid_one: Import only the {{count}} valid row and skip the rest
import.skipInvalid_other: Import only the {{count}} valid rows and skip the rest

products.title: Products
products.description: Goods, raw materials and services you buy, make or sell.
products.searchPlaceholder: Search name, SKU or scan a barcode…

form.newHint: Fill in the General tab; pricing, packs and variants are optional.
form.skuHint: Leave empty to use the next number (Settings › Document numbering).
form.barcodeHint: Scan the manufacturer barcode, or generate an in-store one.
form.baseUnitHint: Stock is counted in this unit.
form.reorderHint: You will be warned when stock falls to this level.
form.trackBatchHint: Record a batch / lot number on every receipt and sale.
form.trackSerialHint: Each unit has its own serial number (electronics, machines).
form.trackExpiryHint: Record expiry dates and sell the earliest first.
form.serviceNoStock: Services are not stocked, so tracking is turned off.

errors.duplicateUnit: Each unit can be added only once
errors.baseUnitPack: The base unit cannot also be a pack

units.title: Packs & units
units.description: Sell or buy in other units, e.g. 1 carton = 12 pcs. Empty prices are worked out from the base price.

variants.enableHint: Sizes, colours… each variant has its own SKU, barcode and price.
variants.noAttributes: Create attributes (e.g. Size, Color) under Inventory › Attributes first.

images.saveFirst: Save the product first, then add images.
images.hint: Up to {{max}} images (JPG, PNG or WEBP). The first image is shown in lists and on the POS.
images.limit: A product can have at most {{max}} images

brands.title: Brands
brands.description: Manufacturers and brands of your products.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: Variant options such as size and colour.
attributes.intro: Attributes and their values are used to build product variants (e.g. Size: S, M, L × Color: Red, Blue).
attributes.valuesHint: Type a value and press Enter. Values used by variants cannot be removed.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Group products in a tree, e.g. Grocery › Rice.
categories.dragHint: Drag a category up or down to reorder it, or sideways to change its level.

labels.title: Barcode labels
labels.description: Print price and barcode labels for shelves and products.
labels.emptyHint: Search above, or select products on the Products page and choose “Print labels”.

customer.title: Customers
customer.description: People and businesses you sell to.
customer.alsoOtherHint: The same party will appear in Suppliers too.
customer.openingHint: Amount the customer owed when you started using Holydeen.

supplier.title: Suppliers
supplier.description: Vendors and manufacturers you buy from.
supplier.alsoOtherHint: The same party will appear in Customers too.
supplier.openingHint: Amount you owed the supplier when you started using Holydeen.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Group parties for pricing and reports.

inventory.pickWarehouseFirst: Choose a warehouse first, then add items.
inventory.serialHint: One serial per unit. Scan or type each one and press Enter.
inventory.serialPlaceholder: Scan or type a serial number
inventory.defaultReasonHint: Used for lines without their own reason.
inventory.approvalNotice: Approval is required: after you submit, a user with the Approve permission must approve this document before stock changes.

kindsHint.adjustment: Add or remove stock with a reason, e.g. found, lost or a count correction.
kindsHint.opening: Enter the stock on hand when you start using the system. Only allowed before any other movement of the item in that warehouse.
kindsHint.damage: Write off damaged stock. Serial numbers are marked as damaged.
kindsHint.scrap: Write off stock that is scrapped. Serial numbers are marked as scrapped.

confirm.approveText: Stock and its value will change now. Posted documents cannot be edited; corrections need a new adjustment.
confirm.approveCountText: The differences between counted and system quantities will be posted to stock now.
confirm.cancelText: It stays on record as cancelled and no stock changes.
confirm.cancelTransitText: The dispatched stock returns to the source warehouse at its original cost.
confirm.dispatchText: Stock leaves the source warehouse now and stays in transit until it is received.
confirm.receiveText: The items will be added to {{warehouse}}.

reject.title: Reject document
reject.description: The creator can correct and resubmit it.

validation.serialCount: Enter one serial number per unit

picker.search: Add item by name, SKU or barcode
picker.typeToSearch: Type a name, SKU or barcode

stock.title: Stock
stock.description: Current quantity and value of every item.

card.title: Stock card
card.timelineHint: Every stock movement with the running balance after it.

warehouses.title: Warehouses
warehouses.description: Stock held in each warehouse of your branches.

adjustments.title: Adjustments
adjustments.description: Opening stock, adjustments, damage and scrap.

transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.description: Move stock between warehouses and branches.
transfers.newHint: Choose where stock leaves from and where it goes, then add the items.

counts.title: Stock counts
counts.description: Physical inventory: count, review variances and post adjustments.
counts.newHint: A count sheet lists the items in stock now. Batch items get one line per batch; serial-tracked items are counted with adjustments.
counts.includeZeroHint: Also list active items that show zero, to catch stock that isn't recorded.
counts.emptyText: Start a count to compare what is on the shelves with the system.
counts.searchPlaceholder: Find item, SKU, barcode or batch…
counts.invalid: Some counted quantities are not valid numbers
counts.hint: Blank lines are treated as not counted and are not adjusted. Variance is measured against stock at the moment of posting.

movements.title: Stock movements
movements.description: The stock ledger: every movement in and out, permanent and in posting order.

serials.title: Serial numbers
serials.description: Where each serial-tracked unit is and what happened to it.

alerts.title: Stock alerts
alerts.noneLow: No items below their reorder level

notifications.lowStockHint: At or below the reorder level
notifications.expiredHint: Still in stock — write off or return

reports.title: Inventory reports
reports.description: Valuation, slow-moving and dead stock, ABC analysis and expiry.

purchase.addItemsForTotals: Add items to see the totals.

convert.toRfqHint: Creates a draft RFQ with the lines still to order for the suppliers you choose.
convert.toOrderHint: Creates a draft purchase order with the lines still to order, at the products' purchase prices.

confirm.cancelText: It stays on record as cancelled.
confirm.cancelBillText: The bill is cancelled and its quantities can be billed again.
confirm.closeText: Nothing more will be received or billed against it.
confirm.postReceiptText: Stock and its value increase now at the landed cost. Posted receipts cannot be edited — send goods back with a return.
confirm.postBillText: The bill becomes payable to the supplier.
confirm.postReturnText: The goods leave stock now and the value is credited to the supplier.
confirm.postDebitNoteText: The value is credited to the supplier; stock does not change.

approval.title: Approval
approval.decidedOnSubmit: Approval levels are decided from the total when you submit.

requisitions.title: Requisitions
requisitions.description: Internal requests to buy, before anything is ordered.
requisitions.newHint: List what is needed; once approved it can become an RFQ or a purchase order.

rfqs.title: Requests for quotation
rfqs.description: Ask several suppliers for prices and award the best offer.
rfqs.newHint: Add the items and invite suppliers, then record their quotes.
rfqs.comparisonHint: Net unit prices; the best price per line is highlighted.
rfqs.awardText: A draft purchase order for {{total}} is created at the quoted prices.
rfqs.quoteHint: Prices per unit as quoted, excluding tax. Leave blank for lines not quoted.

orders.title: Purchase orders
orders.description: Orders to suppliers, their approval, receiving and billing.
orders.newHint: Choose the supplier and add items; submitting sends it for approval.

receipts.title: Goods receipts
receipts.description: Goods received from suppliers (GRN). Posting adds them to stock at landed cost.
receipts.newHint: Receive goods without an order, or use “Receive goods” on a purchase order.
receipts.partialHint: Lower the quantities to receive part of the order; the rest stays open on the PO.
receipts.landedHint: Freight, duty and other costs to bring the goods in. They are added to the items' stock cost.
receipts.costingDraft: As saved — recalculated when you save.
receipts.costingPosted: The cost each item entered stock at.

bills.title: Bills
bills.newHint: Record a supplier invoice; from an order or receipt use “Create bill”.

payments.title: Supplier payments
payments.description: Payments to suppliers and how they settle bills.
payments.newHint: Pay a supplier and choose which bills it settles. Anything left stays as an advance.
payments.overAllocated: Allocations are more than the payment.
payments.pickSupplierFirst: Choose a supplier to see their open bills.
payments.existingCreditsHint: Earlier advances and debit notes can settle bills too.
payments.voidHint: Its allocations are removed and the bills reopen. Give a reason for the record.

returnTypeHints.return: Goods go back to the supplier: stock decreases.
returnTypeHints.debit_note: A claim on the supplier without goods moving (short supply, price difference).

returns.title: Returns & debit notes
returns.description: Goods sent back and claims against suppliers.
returns.newHint: Use “Return goods” on a receipt or “Debit note” on a bill to start from it.
returns.empty: No returns or debit notes yet

payables.title: Payables
payables.description: What is owed to suppliers and how overdue it is.
payables.byDueHint: Open bill balances by days past their due date.
payables.byBillHint: Open bill balances by days since the bill date.

email.title: Email {{number}}
email.description: The purchase order is attached as a PDF.
email.subject: Purchase order {{number}}
email.body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

Please find attached our purchase order {{number}}. Kindly confirm receipt and the delivery date, and quote the PO number on your challan and invoice.

Thank you.

sales.searchCustomer: Search by name, code or phone…
sales.termsHint: Blank = the default terms from Settings → Sales.
sales.serialHint: Scan or type the serial numbers going out — one per unit.

convert.pickWarehouse: Choose the warehouse the goods will ship from.

confirm.declineText: The customer turned the quotation down. It can no longer be converted.
confirm.cancelQuotationText: The quotation will be cancelled and can no longer be converted.
confirm.cancelOrderText: Only orders with nothing delivered or invoiced can be cancelled.
confirm.closeText: Whatever is still undelivered will not be delivered. Use this to short-close an order.
confirm.postChallanText: Stock leaves the warehouse now. A posted challan can't be edited.
confirm.cancelChallanText: The draft challan will be cancelled.
confirm.cancelInvoiceText: Only drafts, or unpaid invoices with no receipts applied, can be cancelled. Stock taken out by this invoice goes back.
confirm.postReturnText: Goods come back into stock at their original cost, and the amount is credited to the customer.
confirm.postCreditNoteText: The amount is credited to the customer. Stock does not change.

credit.title: Credit limit exceeded
credit.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Owner approved — payment promised on Friday
credit.logged: The override is recorded with your name on this document.

quotations.title: Quotations
quotations.description: Price offers to customers; convert accepted ones to orders or invoices.
quotations.newHint: Prices come from the customer's price list; you can change them.
quotations.validHint: Blank = {{days}} days from the quotation date.

orders.title: Sales orders
orders.description: Confirmed customer orders — deliver them in one or more challans, then invoice.
orders.newHint: Confirming checks the customer's credit limit.

challans.title: Delivery challans
challans.description: Goods sent to customers. Posting a challan takes the stock out.
challans.newHint: Usually created from a sales order for what is still to deliver.
challans.costHint: At FIFO / average cost when the challan was posted.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.description: Customer invoices, what's paid and what's still due.
invoices.newHint: Lines not delivered by a challan take stock out when the invoice is posted.
invoices.warehouseHint: For lines that are not delivered by a challan.

receipts.title: Money receipts
receipts.description: Payments received from customers and the invoices they settle.
receipts.newHint: Record money received and apply it to open invoices. Anything left is kept as an advance.
receipts.allocationHint: Oldest invoices first. Leave blank to keep the money as an advance.
receipts.pickCustomerFirst: Choose a customer to see their open invoices.
receipts.noOpenInvoices: This customer has no open invoices.
receipts.existingCreditsHint: Advances and credit notes that can be applied to invoices.
receipts.voidHint: The invoices it paid become due again. Give a reason.

returns.title: Returns & credit notes
returns.description: Goods coming back from customers and price adjustments.
returns.empty: No returns or credit notes yet

typeHints.return: Goods come back into stock; the customer is credited.
typeHints.credit_note: Price adjustment or allowance; no stock movement.

returns.appliesTo: When posted, this is applied to invoice {{number}} first.

receivables.title: Receivables
receivables.description: What each customer owes, by age.
receivables.byInvoiceHint: Age counted from the invoice date.

ledger.title: Customer ledger
ledger.advanceHint: Negative: the customer has paid in advance

priceLists.title: Price lists
priceLists.description: Special prices for customer groups — fixed prices or a % off the standard price.
priceLists.formHint: When several lists apply, the one with the highest priority wins.
priceLists.name: Name
priceLists.groupHint: Leave as “All customers” for a general list.
priceLists.pricesHint: Add items and set a fixed price or a % off. A minimum quantity makes the price apply only from that quantity.
priceLists.deleteText: Customers in the group go back to standard prices.

recurring.title: Recurring invoices
recurring.description: Invoices that repeat on a schedule. They are created every night at 01:00.
recurring.emptyHint: Open a posted invoice and choose “Repeat”.
recurring.hint: A copy of this invoice is created on each date, with the same items and prices.
recurring.name: Name
recurring.firstRunHint: Blank = one period after this invoice.
recurring.autoPostHint: Otherwise each new invoice waits as a draft.
recurring.autoEmailHint: Sends the invoice to the customer's email once posted.
recurring.deleteText: No more invoices will be created. Invoices already made stay.

remind.title: Send a payment reminder
remind.description: Emails the customer the amount due and the due date.
remind.messagePlaceholder: Added above the standard reminder text

email.title: Email invoice {{number}}
email.subject: Invoice {{number}}
email.body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

Please find attached invoice {{number}}.

Thank you for your business.

doc.previewHint: This is exactly what is printed, downloaded and emailed.

pos.noCachedItems: No items on this device yet — connect once to download them.
pos.emptyCart: Scan or tap items to add them
pos.serialsMissing: Scan the serial numbers of {{name}} first
pos.cartDiscountHint: Spread over the items before VAT.
pos.heldHint: Carts parked on any register of this branch.
pos.cartReplaced: The cart was replaced by the held order
pos.clearText: All items, the customer and discounts are removed.
pos.paymentHint: Split between cash, card and bKash as needed. Only cash can be more than due — the rest is change.
pos.nonCashOver: Card, wallet and credit can't be more than the bill.
pos.payInFull: Walk-in sales must be paid in full.
pos.saleQueued: Sale saved offline — it will sync when the connection is back
pos.offlineDisabled: The connection is down and offline selling is turned off
pos.customerHint: Walk-in, an existing customer, or add a new one.
pos.queueOnline: Sales made offline are sent to the server automatically.
pos.queueOffline: Working offline — sales are kept on this device until the connection is back.
pos.noRegistersHint: Ask an administrator to set up a register for your branch.
pos.offlineNoSession: The register isn't open and the connection is down. Open it once you're back online.
pos.openRegisterHint: Count the cash in the drawer to start the shift.
pos.cashInOutHint: Money put into or taken out of the drawer, with a reason.
pos.cashReason: Reason (e.g. change float, tea, bank deposit)
pos.closeRegisterHint: Count the drawer by note and coin. The Z report is printed.
pos.closingNotes: Closing notes (e.g. why the cash is short)
pos.syncBeforeClose_one: {{count}} offline sale still has to sync before closing.
pos.syncBeforeClose_other: {{count}} offline sales still have to sync before closing.
pos.returnsHint: Scan or type the receipt number.
pos.exchangeHint: The amount becomes store credit and is taken off the next sale.
pos.exchangeReady: Credit {{amount}} applied — add the new items

receipt.title: Sales receipt
receipt.offlineNote: Recorded offline — the invoice number follows after sync.

sessions.title: Register sessions
sessions.description: Every shift with its Z report and cash variance.

accounts.title: Chart of Accounts
accounts.description: Group accounts are headings; ledger accounts receive postings. Balances are as of today.
accounts.typeFromParent: Taken from the group it sits under.
accounts.isGroupHint: Groups hold other accounts and cannot receive postings.

journals.title: Journal Entries
journals.description: Every posting in the general ledger — manual entries and those posted by documents.
journals.newHint: Debits must equal credits. Save a draft or post it now.
journals.debitOrCredit: Enter either a debit or a credit
journals.twoLines: A journal needs at least two lines
journals.autoHint: Posted by its document. To undo it, cancel or void that document.
journals.reverseHint: A new entry with the debits and credits swapped is posted on the date you choose.

fiscal.title: Fiscal Years
fiscal.description: Lock a month to stop any posting dated in it. Closing a year moves its profit or loss to retained earnings.

confirm.closeText: Every period is locked and a closing entry moves the income and expense balances to retained earnings.
confirm.reopenText: The closing entry is reversed. Periods stay locked until you unlock them.
confirm.deleteText: The year and its periods are removed. Journal entries are not affected.

opening.title: Opening Balances
opening.description: Balances of your accounts on the day you start using the system.
opening.accountsHint: Customers, suppliers and stock are not listed — they have their own opening balances.
opening.equityHint: The difference between debits and credits goes here.
opening.elsewhere: Opening balances for customers, suppliers and stock are entered on:

health.title: Ledger Health
health.description: Checks the general ledger against receivables, payables and stock.
health.allGoodHint: Debits equal credits and the control accounts agree with the documents.
health.issuesHint: Documents recorded before accounting was set up may not have journals yet — "Post missing journals" adds them. Manual journals on control accounts also cause differences.
health.inventoryHint: Inventory account against the stock valuation.
health.receivablesHint: Accounts receivable against customer balances from sales documents.
health.payablesHint: Accounts payable against supplier balances from purchase documents.

accounting.voidHint: A reversing entry is posted today. The document stays on record as void.

bank.title: Cash & Bank Accounts
bank.description: Cash, bank and mobile-wallet accounts, each with its own ledger account and balance.
bank.linkLedgerHint: Leave on "Create a new ledger account" unless the ledger already exists in the chart.

vouchers.title: Vouchers
vouchers.description: Money in and out that is not a customer receipt or supplier payment, and transfers between accounts.

hint.receipt: Money received into a cash / bank account — other income, a loan, capital.
hint.payment: Money paid out of a cash / bank account — rent, utilities, salaries, loan repayment.
hint.contra: Money moved between your own accounts — a cash deposit, a withdrawal, bank to bank.

vouchers.noCustomers: Customer and supplier money is recorded as a money receipt (Sales) or supplier payment (Purchase), not here.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.description: Bills paid straight from cash or bank, by category, with the receipt attached.
expenses.newHint: Bills bought on credit go through Purchase → Bills instead.
expenses.vatHint: Rebatable VAT on the bill (0 if none).

expenseCategories.title: Expense Categories
expenseCategories.description: Each category posts to an expense account in the chart.
expenseCategories.accountHint: Expenses in this category are debited here.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.hint: Bills and receipts (PDF, JPG, PNG). Only signed-in users with accounting access can open them.
attachments.saveFirst: Save the expense to attach its receipt.

cheques.title: Cheques
cheques.description: Received and issued cheques — added automatically from money receipts and supplier payments by cheque.
cheques.emptyHint: Record a money receipt or supplier payment with the "Cheque" payment method.

hint.deposit: The cheque is taken to the bank. It stays in "cheques in hand" until it clears.
hint.clear: The bank has paid the cheque. A received cheque moves from cheques in hand to the bank account.
hint.bounce: The cheque was dishonoured. Its money receipt / supplier payment is voided, so the balance is owed again.

recon.title: Bank Reconciliation
recon.description: Match the ledger of a bank account with its statement.
recon.newHint: Enter the closing balance and date printed on the bank statement.
recon.emptyHint: Start one when the monthly bank statement arrives.
recon.workspaceHint: Tick what appears on the statement, or import it and match.
recon.importHint: Upload the CSV or Excel statement, then say which column is which. The choice is remembered for this account.
recon.amountHint: Use the withdrawal and deposit columns, or one amount column where withdrawals are negative.
recon.completeText: The ticked lines stay cleared and the next reconciliation starts from this statement balance.
recon.deleteText: Its ticks and imported statement lines are removed. Ledger entries are not affected.
recon.ledgerHint: Book balance {{balance}} · not yet on the statement: deposits {{deposits}}, payments {{payments}}.
recon.noLedger: No ledger lines up to the statement date
recon.statementHint: Imported lines. Match them to the ledger, or book charges and interest the ledger doesn’t have.
recon.noStatement: No statement imported — tick the ledger lines by hand, or import the statement.
recon.sameAmount: Only lines with the same amount are listed.
recon.bookHint: Posts a {{kind}} voucher of {{amount}} on this account and matches it.

reports.title: Financial Reports
reports.description: Statements and ledgers from the posted journals, by period and branch.
reports.unbalanced: The figures do not balance — check the ledger.
reports.pickAccount: Choose an account to see its ledger.

profit-loss.title: Profit & Loss
profit-loss.description: Income, cost of sales and expenses for a period.

balance-sheet.title: Balance Sheet
balance-sheet.description: Assets, liabilities and equity on a date.

cash-flow.title: Cash Flow
cash-flow.description: Where cash came from and went (indirect method).

trial-balance.title: Trial Balance
trial-balance.description: Opening, movements and closing of every account.

general-ledger.title: General Ledger
general-ledger.description: Every posting on an account with a running balance.

day-book.title: Day Book
day-book.description: All journal entries of a period, day by day.

validation.endBeforeStart: The end is before the start

workCenters.title: Work Centers
workCenters.description: Where operations run: daily capacity and hourly labour and overhead rates for costing.

boms.title: Bills of Materials
boms.description: What goes into each product, in what quantity, through which operations.
boms.newHint: Components (with wastage), by-products, routing and quality checkpoints for one product.
boms.outputHint: How many units (base unit) these components make.
boms.makesHint: The finished good or sub-assembly this BOM produces.
boms.componentsHint: Quantities are for the output quantity, in each item’s base unit. A component with its own BOM is a sub-assembly.
boms.byproductsHint: Received with the product; each takes its share of the cost.
boms.operationsHint: Operations in order. Setup minutes are per order; run minutes per output quantity.
boms.qualityChecksHint: Each must be recorded before an order can be completed.
boms.standardCostFor: For {{quantity}} units — compared with each order’s actual cost.

confirm.activateText: It becomes read-only and the default for its product. Change it later through a new version.
confirm.archiveText: New orders can no longer use it. Existing orders keep their materials.
confirm.deleteText: Only BOMs no order has used can be deleted.

orders.title: Manufacturing Orders
orders.description: Plan, issue materials, run operations, check quality and receive finished goods.
orders.newHint: Materials and routing are copied from the BOM when you save.
orders.plannedEndHint: Leave empty to work it out from the routing (8-hour days).
orders.noBom: This product has no active BOM.
orders.operationsHint: Finishing an operation charges its labour and overhead to work in progress.
orders.scrapHint: Recorded for the wastage report; the cost stays in the order.

cost.title: Cost: standard vs actual
cost.hint: Standard from the BOM at planning; actual from issued materials and finished operations.

dialogs.issueText: From {{warehouse}}. Lot-tracked items are picked first-expiry-first.
dialogs.returnText: Back into {{warehouse}} at the cost they were issued at.
dialogs.finishText: Planned: {{planned}}. Enter the time it took.
dialogs.failActionHint: Scrap: written off at closing as production variance. Rework: the order goes back to production.
dialogs.scrapText: Material or product wasted during production.
dialogs.completeText: {{quantity}} good units go into {{warehouse}} at actual cost.

confirm.confirmText: Materials can then be issued. The plan can still be rescheduled.
confirm.startText: Operations can then be started and finished on the shop floor.
confirm.closeText: Whatever cost the output did not absorb (scrap, rounding) is posted as production variance.
confirm.reopenText: The variance entry is reversed so materials can still be returned.
confirm.deleteText: The order number is not reused.

mrp.title: Material Planning (MRP)
mrp.description: What the open orders still need against stock, purchase orders, requisitions and production.
mrp.emptyHint: Open manufacturing orders that still need materials show up here.

board.title: Production Board
board.description: Open orders by stage. Drag a card to confirm it, issue its materials or start production.
board.openToContinue: Open {{number}} to continue — this step needs details.
board.noPermission: You are not allowed to do that.

schedule.title: Production Schedule
schedule.description: Planned orders on a timeline. Hover a bar for its operations.

reports.title: Manufacturing Reports
reports.description: Output, consumption, wastage, cost variance and work-center load for a period.
